name: Knight techniques
notes: Knight techniques (ADR-0004: learned from trainers; chains Shield Bash → Shield Charge → Shield Vault and Parry → Riposte → Disarm). Seeded with the knight's starting pair from class data (mw-e19.4); the moves themselves are src/content/data/move/shield-bash.json and shield-parry.json (mw-e04). The knight's trainer-taught techniques (mw-ju8.13) are bought from Sergeant Maud Garrick at the Bridgeward College (ADR-0004 chains: shield chain step 2, parry chain steps 2-3, barge chain step 1). Combat does not check these ids yet.

capabilities.name: Shield Bash
capabilities.description: Drive the shield into a guard to stagger them and break their stance (ADR-0004 shield chain, step 1).

capabilities.name: Parry
capabilities.description: Turn a blow aside at the last moment and open the attacker to a riposte (ADR-0004 parry chain, step 1). A knight signature: never shared.

capabilities.name: Riposte
capabilities.description: Answer a parry with a critical counter-blow (ADR-0004 parry chain, step 2).

capabilities.name: Disarm
capabilities.description: Take the weapon from the hand you just parried (ADR-0004 parry chain, step 3).

capabilities.name: Shield Charge
capabilities.description: Run shield-first through a line of foes (ADR-0004 shield chain, step 2).

capabilities.name: Shoulder Barge
capabilities.description: Burst rotten boards and bar-doors with a lowered shoulder (ADR-0004 barge chain, step 1).
